title: Orchestr8 Custom Agent Create Request
description: Payload for POST /v1/agents — the operator-authored role form in the Console team panel. Name, description and skill are the only operator inputs; id, provider, model, contract and provenance are derived by services.custom_agents.

name.description: Display label. Slugified into the agent id.

description.description: One-line summary shown on the role card and used as the contract mission.

skill.description: Long-form instructions written to the role's skill.md and loaded as its system prompt.

defaultModel.description: Optional catalog model id. Defaults to the first configured provider's fallback head.
